ngaap.guidance: 2021 guidance initiated 29-Jan-2021: Revenue $18.5 billion - $18.9 billion, up organically 3.0% - 5.0%. GAAP net income margin of 10.8% - 11.1%. Adjusted EBIT margin of 18.0% - 18.5%. GAAP EPS of $9.80 - $10.11. Non-GAAP EPS of $12.60 - $13.00. Operating cash flow and adjusted free cash flow of $3.1 billion - $3.2 billion and $2.8 billion - $2.9 billion, respectively. ~$2.3 billion in share repurchases, excluding use of divestiture proceeds. Quarterly dividend raised 20% from $.85 to $1.02 per share; new $6 billion share repurchase authorization. Guidance tables (CY'21): revenue $18,500 - $18,900; net income $2,002 - $2,090; net interest expense ~255; income taxes 310 - 364; L3Harris Merger integration costs 75 - 100; amortization of acquisition-related intangibles ~688; total adjustments 1,328 - 1,407; adjusted EBIT $3,330 - $3,497 (18.0% - 18.5%). EPS bridge: GAAP $9.80 - $10.11; integration 0.36 - 0.48; amortization ~3.34; NCI portion ~(0.02); total pre-tax 3.68 - 3.80; income taxes 0.88 - 0.91; after-tax 2.80 - 2.89; non-GAAP $12.60 - $13.00. Cash flow: operating cash flow $3,100 - $3,175; additions of PP&E ~(375); free cash flow 2,725 - 2,800; cash used for integration 75 - 100; adjusted FCF $2,800 - $2,900.
ngaap.notes: Non-GAAP EPS = income from continuing operations per diluted share attributable to common shareholders, excluding L3Harris Merger integration costs, amortization of acquisition-related intangibles (ALL acquired intangibles, incl. Exelis), fair-value inventory step-up, divestiture expenses/losses, restructuring and other items, impairment of goodwill and other assets / COVID-19 charges, net of the noncontrolling-interest portion and of income taxes. Adjusted EBIT = net income + discontinued operations + net interest expense + income taxes + the same pre-tax items (i.e. it INCLUDES non-operating income / non-service FAS pension income). Adjusted free cash flow = operating cash flow - net additions of PP&E + cash used for L3Harris Merger integration (and transaction) costs. From this quarter free cash flow = operating cash flow - additions of PP&E + proceeds from sale of PP&E ($91m in the quarter; the related $22m gain on sale of PP&E is excluded from non-GAAP). FCF bridge values are the QUARTER column. Dollar tax effect not published in this release; the Q4-21 release later shows the Q4-20 adjustments as EBIT adjustments 553 (257 Aviation Systems + 298 unallocated items - 2 non-operating), income-tax effect (73), non-GAAP income from continuing operations 664. Classification of the lease-expense adjustment ('op') and the debt-refinancing gain ('nonop'; non-operating income table of the 10-K) is by nature. Revenue excluding Commercial Aviation Solutions and Public Safety: 4,464 vs 4,304 (+3.7%).
